messages:
matt_partner_bd: Hey team — AcceleX confirmed their EU-West4 capacity window and wants marketplace listing + entitlement for the launch. Target ETA: Mar 31. Can we run a quick checklist for quota, marketplace assets, and SI handoff?

Dana_ops: Thanks — can you drop SKU IDs and rough capacity numbers? I'll start the quota flow once we have SKUs.

lina_hw_partner: SKUs: ACX-EU4-80GB, ACX-EU4-40GB. Initial commit: 8 racks (~64 GPUs). Partner portal with docs: https://partners.accelex.com/eu-west4/onboard

raj_infra: 64 GPUs is reasonable. For marketplace we'll need separate marketplace SKU mappings for Hosted vs Dedicated and quota buckets per customer tier (trial/standard/enterprise). I'll draft a quota table and tagging scheme.

sarah_pm: Also we need joint announcement timing — Sales requests a two-week lead. Proposed launch window Apr 18-22 so ops/sales have runway.

ellie_legal: Legal has no red flags on standard marketplace terms. We will need a short MOU for the SI integration and a data-processing appendix for enterprise customers. Matt, can Partnerships own the SI SOW coordination?

matt_partner_bd: Yes, Partnerships will coordinate the SI scope with Sales and the partner's SI team. We'll surface SOW template and attach to the MOU.

tom_sales: Sales asks whether partner can provide an introductory promo (discount/credits) for first customers to drive pipeline. Also need suggested list pricing for Dedicated SKUs.

lina_hw_partner: We can provide 20% promo credits for first 60 days on Dedicated SKUs. We'll also upload logos, spec sheets, and reference benchmarks by Mar 20.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Quota ticket created: Q-2026-7743 — https://redwood.internal/tickets/Q-2026-7743 (assigned to @raj_infra)

dana_ops: Raj — can you paste the quota table here (vCPU/GPU, SKU, marketplace_id, billing_class, initial_limit)? Need it for the ticket and cloud partner to provision entitlements.

raj_infra: Posting initial config CSV:

```
sku,marketplace_id,billing_class,gpu_count,initial_limit
ACX-EU4-80GB,acx.eu4.80,dedicated,8,8
ACX-EU4-40GB,acx.eu4.40,hosted,4,16
ACX-EU4-40GB-ENT,acx.eu4.40.ent,enterprise,4,24
```

raj_infra: I'll attach this to Q-2026-7743 and start quota provider flow. Note: Need marketplace_id mapping from Lina's portal for final alignment.

sarah_pm: Action items summary: 1) Raj open quota request (Q-2026-7743) — in progress. 2) Lina upload marketplace assets + final SKU docs by Mar 20. 3) Ellie draft MOU + DPA by Mar 18. 4) Matt coordinate SI SOW and SIs list by Mar 22. 5) Sales to confirm pricing promo and field comms. I'll schedule a pre-launch review for Apr 8. @everyone please ack.

matt_partner_bd: ack

lina_hw_partner: ack :thumbsup:

ellie_legal: will start draft today

tom_sales: will prep pricing + deck

dana_ops: monitoring the ticket, will validate quotas once provider responds

raj_infra: table posted and quota workflow started — will update ticket with provider ETA and any additional quota IDs.
